rules.description: Ensure latest observation year is within allowable annual release lag

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS max_year FROM stats

rules.description: Ensure all core StatVars (excluding sparse ToBeDetermined subgroup) advance to the dataset's latest observation year

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS max_year, (SELECT MAX(CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER)) FROM stats) AS dataset_max_year FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT LIKE '%ToBeDetermined%'
